text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah (Perancangan)

Wilayah Persekutuan (Fi bagi Pembelian Draf Pelan Tempatan

Kuala Lumpur 2040) 2024.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 31 Januari 2024.

Fi

2. Fi bagi pembelian salinan draf Pelan Tempatan Kuala Lumpur 2040 hendaklah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Kaedah 2]

Salinan Fi bagi setiap

salinan

(RM)

(a) dalam bahasa kebangsaan

(i) salinan cetak 250.00

(ii) bentuk elektronik 100.00

(b) dalam bahasa Inggeris

(i) salinan cetak 250.00

(ii) bentuk elektronik 100.00

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEE FOR PURCHASE OF DRAFT OF

KUALA LUMPUR LOCAL PLAN 2040) RULES 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 13, 14 and paragraph 64(2)(j)

of the Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner,

with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning) (Fee for

Purchase of Draft of Kuala Lumpur Local Plan 2040) Rules 2024.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 31 January 2024.

Fee

2. The fee for the purchase of a copy of the draft of Kuala Lumpur Local Plan 2040

shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

Copy Fee per copy

(RM)

(a) in the national language

(i) hard copy 250.00

(ii) electronic form 100.00

(b) in the English language

(i) hard copy 250.00

(ii) electronic form 100.00

Made 29 January 2024

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/808 JLD.12; PN(PU2)396/Jld.9]
